result:
I reviewed the actual diff (not the self-report) against `SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md`'s standing rules, cross-checking the real implementation files (`auth-guard.ts`, `api-key-auth.ts`, `report-engine-service.ts`, and the already-merged PROJEXA sibling route) rather than trusting PROGRESS.md's claims.

**Verdict: reject** (tier1 as pre-classified). Tenant isolation is genuinely solid and well-tested — orgId always comes from the authenticated context, never the request body, verified by a real spoofing test. But the new CSV export path (`rowsToCSV` in `src/lib/report-export-shared.ts`) has no formula-injection sanitization, and it's the codebase's first server-side CSV endpoint, purpose-built for external AI agents/resellers to consume — report rows contain user-controlled free text (vendor names, item names) that could carry a `=`/`+`/`-`/`@`-prefixed payload executed as a live formula when opened downstream. Since tier1 approval here means autonomous merge to main with no human gate, I flagged this as blocking rather than a follow-up note. Full details and a secondary minor nitpick are in `review-verdict.json`.
